description: This file declares the HttpRequest class, which encapsulates HTTP request handling within the rialto::servermanager namespace. It provides methods to access request details such as method, command, post data, and parameters, and to send replies. The class interacts with external structures mg_connection and mg_request_info from the mongoose library.

classes.name: HttpRequest
classes.description: A class representing an HTTP request, providing accessors for request details and a reply method.

methods.name: HttpRequest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HttpRequest object with a connection and request info.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command or path component of the request.

methods.name: getPostData
methods.description: Returns the POST data of the request.

methods.name: getParams
methods.description: Returns the parameters extracted from the request.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Sends a reply message back through the connection.
